evidence_items.publisher: Anthropic, PBC / US Securities and Exchange Commission
evidence_items.locator: Risk Factors, page 64; historical financial statements and auditor reports
evidence_items.explanation: The accompanying risk disclosure reports a 2024 net loss of $8.3 billion and losses in every year since founding. This supports the description for Anthropic, but one company cannot establish the population claim and the contract supplies no matching accounting basis.

evidence_items.locator: Opening financial highlights; Consolidated Statements of Income, page 5
evidence_items.explanation: Alphabet reports positive consolidated net income for the quarter and year. This is material contrary context under a broad whole-company reading, but it neither isolates GenAI model-building profits nor establishes a majority.

unresolved_gaps: No representative company-count denominator or sufficiently complete set of comparable financial results.
No specified accounting basis; the money-claim rules therefore prevent a supported or contradicted verdict.
Historical accounts are insufficient to establish how many companies had ever made a profit.
Consolidated parent profits cannot establish the profitability of their model-building operations.
